_comment: Curated LAN/online verdicts, keyed '<season year>:<event name>'. These win
over LPDB's tournament type, so an entry here is a statement that the
source is absent or wrong. Each carries a reason and a reviewed flag; the
quality report lists every entry still marked reviewed=false, and those
are applied but published as provisional.
Empty, and that is the target state. It once held nine CWL open events
whose reason was 'no matching LPDB tournament page'. The pages exist; the
tournament pull was scoped to the premier circuit and the nine are tier 2.
Widening that scope and aliasing the six 2018 pagenames lets rule 2 answer
all nine from LPDB's own tournament type. An entry belongs here only when
the source cannot answer at all.
